meta.name: Team Liquid
meta.description:
24/7 access to one of the world’s top esports teams. Live matches, exclusive content, and behind-the-scenes moments that show just exactly how massive esports is and what it takes to be a team that stands at the top.

Shows: The Ultimate Ward Guide, Spicy 1v1s!, From Jungle Paths to Pasta Plates: Worlds Insights & Bites, Grand Final Loses, WOW: Final Mythic Guides
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
